blocks.html: Robinsons Land recently opened another retail landmark in the Mindanao region, its 45th mall- Robinsons Place Iligan located within the first mixed-use complex in Brgy. Tubod, Iligan City. The mixed-use complex, featuring a three-level full service mall and a 108-room Go Hotels chain is Lanao del Norte’s newest lifestyle destination. Dubbed as a world-class mall by Iligan City Mayor Celso G. Regencia, Robinsons Place Iligan opens more than 50,000 square meters of shopping, dining and leisure spaces at the center of the bustling city serving the rapidly expanding market in the province. Anchor tenants such as Robinsons Supermarket, Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Appliances, Handyman, and Daiso are among the stores, which opened on its first day. Apart from bringing into the province the global brands in retail industry, Robinsons Place Iligan will also pioneer state-of-the-art entertainment through Robinsons Movieworld’s six digital cinemas with one 3D and elegantly-designed lobby, ticket counter, snacks counter, and even toilets. Processing of government-related documents is made convenient and accessible for the Iliganons through Robinsons Malls Lingkod Pinoy Center located on the second level of the mall. It is Robinsons Malls’ public service program, which houses various satellite offices of government agencies. Currently operating in Robinsons Place Iligan’s Lingkod Pinoy Center are Pag-IBIG Branch Office, PhilHealth, PHLPost, and soon-to-open SSS, TESDA and PRC Service Center on the third level. Robinsons Place Iligan is one of the six Robinsons Land mall chain in Mindanao following Robinsons Place Cagayan de Oro, Robinsons Cybergate Davao, Robinsons Place GenSan, the newly expanded Robinsons Place Butuan, and Robinsons Place Tagum – all located in key urban cities.
